title: What is the Hub
summary: Ready-made backgrounds, music, sounds, fonts and button presets — one tap into your library.

shots.title: Building blocks for quests
shots.caption: The Hub holds community resources: backgrounds, music, sounds, fonts and button presets. You do not have to make or find everything yourself.

shots.title: Downloads land in your library
shots.caption: Everything you add in the Hub appears in “My library” and becomes available in the quest editor.
